en.title: Spectroscopic Data Processing
en.summary: Signal processing pipeline for microalbumin test spectra in MATLAB.
en.challenge: Microalbumin spectroscopy signals contained baseline drift and measurement noise that obscured concentration-related patterns.
contribution: Prepared and inspected spectral datasets from the laboratory measurement workflow.
Implemented baseline correction and polynomial fitting in MATLAB.
Supported measurement integration and repeatability with Arduino-connected experimental hardware.
technical: Spectrometer and experimental electronics generate raw intensity/wavelength records.
MATLAB performs preprocessing, baseline estimation, correction, fitting, and visualization.
Processed spectra are compared across samples to expose usable analytical patterns.

architecture.label: Measurement
architecture.detail: Sample, light source, spectrometer, and Arduino-linked controls produce raw spectra.

architecture.label: Preprocessing
architecture.detail: MATLAB imports, aligns, filters, and inspects the signal.

architecture.label: Correction
architecture.detail: Polynomial baseline modeling separates drift from the analytical spectrum.

architecture.label: Interpretation
architecture.detail: Corrected curves and fitted features support concentration comparison.

outcomes: Converted noisy laboratory spectra into interpretable analytical data.
Built an early bridge between physical experiments, embedded controls, and data processing.
Demonstrated signal-quality judgment rather than treating preprocessing as a black box.

zh.title: 光譜資料處理
zh.summary: 尿液微白蛋白光譜的訊號處理流程（MATLAB）。
zh.role: 研究助理與資料分析師
zh.challenge: 尿液微白蛋白光譜訊號包含基線漂移與量測雜訊，掩蓋了與濃度相關的模式。
contribution: 整理並檢查實驗室量測流程產生的光譜資料集。
在 MATLAB 中實作基線校正與多項式擬合。
透過 Arduino 連接的實驗硬體，支援量測整合與重複性。
technical: 光譜儀與實驗電子設備產生原始光強度與波長紀錄。
MATLAB 執行前處理、基線估計、校正、擬合與視覺化。
跨樣本比較處理後的光譜，以呈現可用的分析模式。

architecture.label: 量測
architecture.detail: 樣本、光源、光譜儀與 Arduino 連接控制共同產生原始光譜。

architecture.label: 前處理
architecture.detail: MATLAB 匯入、對齊、濾波並檢查訊號。

architecture.label: 校正
architecture.detail: 以多項式基線模型將漂移與分析光譜分離。

architecture.label: 解讀
architecture.detail: 校正曲線與擬合特徵支援濃度比較。

outcomes: 將含雜訊的實驗室光譜轉換為可解讀的分析資料。
建立實體實驗、嵌入式控制與資料處理之間的早期橋梁。
展現對訊號品質的判斷，而非將前處理視為黑箱。
